children.name: Orcinus orca
children.description: The orca (Orcinus orca), or killer whale, is a toothed whale and the largest member of the oceanic dolphin family.

children.name: Orcinus citoniensis
children.description: Orcinus citoniensis is an extinct species of orca identified in the Late Pliocene of Italy and the Early Pleistocene of England.

children.name: Orcinus meyeri
children.description: Orcinus meyeri is an extinct species of Orcinus (killer whales) found in Early Miocene deposits of southern Germany, known from two jaw fragments and 18 isolated teeth.

children.name: Orcinus paleorca
children.description: Orcinus paleorca is an extinct species of Orcinus, the genus of killer whales (orca), dated to the Middle Pleistocene.

children.name: Tursiops truncatus
children.description: The common bottlenose dolphin or Atlantic bottlenose dolphin (Tursiops truncatus) is one of three species of bottlenose dolphin in the genus Tursiops.

children.name: Sousa chinensis
children.description: The Indo-Pacific humpback dolphin (Sousa chinensis) is a species of humpback dolphin inhabiting coastal waters of the eastern Indian and western Pacific Oceans..

children.name: Sousa plumbea
children.description: The Indian Ocean humpback dolphin (Sousa plumbea) is a member of the Delphinidae family occupying coastal areas ranging from Southern Africa to Western Indochina..

children.name: Sousa sahulensis
children.description: The Australian humpback dolphin (Sousa sahulensis) is a species of humpback dolphin and the fourth recognized humpback dolphin species chronologically..

children.name: Cephalorhynchus hectori
children.description: Hector's dolphin (Cephalorhynchus hectori) is one of six dolphin species belonging to the genus Cephalorhynchus..

children.name: Cephalorhynchus commersonii
children.description: Commerson's dolphin (Cephalorhynchus commersonii) is also referred to by the common names jacobita, skunk dolphin, piebald dolphin, panda dolphin, or tonina overa (in South America)..

children.name: Cephalorhynchus eutropia
children.description: The Chilean dolphin (Cephalorhynchus eutropia), also known as the Black dolphin, is one of six dolphins in the genus Cephalorhynchus.

children.name: Cephalorhynchus heavisidii
children.description: Heaviside's dolphin (Cephalorhynchus heavisidii) is one of six dolphins in the genus Cephalorhynchus..

children.name: Delphinus delphis
children.description: The common dolphin (Delphinus delphis) is the most abundant cetacean in the world, with an estimated global population of about six million.

children.name: Pseudorca crassidens
children.description: The false killer whale (Pseudorca crassidens) is a species of oceanic dolphin that is the only extant representative of the genus Pseudorca.

children.name: Globicephala macrorhynchus
children.description: The short-finned pilot whale (Globicephala macrorhynchus) is one of the two species of cetaceans in the genus Globicephala, which it shares with the long-finned pilot whale (G..

children.name: Globicephala melas
children.description: The long-finned pilot whale or pothead whale (Globicephala melas) is a large species of oceanic dolphin..

children.name: Grampus griseus
children.description: Risso's dolphin (Grampus griseus) is the only species of the genus Grampus in the family Delphinidae (dolphins)..

children.name: Lagenorhynchus acutus
children.description: The Atlantic white-sided dolphin (Leucopleurus acutus) is a distinctively coloured dolphin found in the cool to temperate waters of the North Atlantic Ocean.

children.name: Lagenorhynchus albirostris
children.description: The white-beaked dolphin (Lagenorhynchus albirostris) is a marine mammal belonging to the family Delphinidae (oceanic dolphins) in the suborder Odontoceti (toothed whales)..

children.name: Lagenorhynchus obliquidens
children.description: The Pacific white-sided dolphin (Aethalodelphis obliquidens), also known as the hookfin porpoise, is an active dolphin found in the cool or temperate waters of the North Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Lagenorhynchus obscurus
children.description: The dusky dolphin (Aethalodelphis obscurus) is a small oceanic dolphin found in coastal waters of the Southern Hemisphere.

children.name: Lagenorhynchus cruciger
children.description: The hourglass dolphin (Cephalorhynchus cruciger) is a small dolphin in the family Delphinidae that inhabits offshore Antarctic and sub-Antarctic waters.

children.name: Lagenorhynchus australis
children.description: Peale's dolphin (Cephalorhynchus australis) is a small dolphin found in the waters around Tierra del Fuego at the foot of South America..

children.name: Stenella coeruleoalba
children.description: The striped dolphin (Stenella coeruleoalba) is a dolphin found in temperate and tropical waters of all the world's oceans.

children.name: Stenella frontalis
children.description: The Atlantic spotted dolphin (Stenella frontalis) is a dolphin found in warm temperate and tropical waters of the Atlantic Ocean.

children.name: Stenella attenuata
children.description: The pantropical spotted dolphin is a species of dolphin found in all the world's temperate and tropical oceans. The species was beginning to come under threat due to the killing of millions of individuals in tuna purse seines. In the 1980s, the rise of "dolphin-friendly" tuna capture methods saved millions of the species in the eastern Pacific Ocean and it is now one of the most abundant dolphin species in the world.

children.name: Stenella clymene
children.description: The Clymene dolphin (Stenella clymene), in older texts known as the short-snouted spinner dolphin, is a dolphin endemic to the Atlantic Ocean.

children.name: Stenella longirostris
children.description: The spinner dolphin (Stenella longirostris) is a small dolphin found in off-shore tropical waters around the world.

children.name: Steno bredanensis
children.description: The rough-toothed dolphin (Steno bredanensis) is a species of dolphin that lives in deep warm and tropical waters around the world..

children.name: Feresa attenuata
children.description: The pygmy killer whale (Feresa attenuata) is a poorly known and rarely seen oceanic dolphin.

children.name: Lagenodelphis hosei
children.description: Fraser's dolphin or the Sarawak dolphin (Lagenodelphis hosei) is a cetacean in the family Delphinidae found in deep waters in the Pacific Ocean and to a lesser extent in the Indian and Atlantic Oceans..

children.name: Lissodelphis borealis
children.description: The northern right whale dolphin (Lissodelphis borealis) is a small, slender species of cetacean found in the cold and temperate waters of the North Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Lissodelphis peronii
children.description: The southern right whale dolphin (Lissodelphis peronii) is a small and slender species of cetacean, found in cool waters of the Southern Hemisphere.

children.name: Sotalia fluviatilis
children.description: The tucuxi (Sotalia fluviatilis), alternatively known in Peru bufeo gris or bufeo negro, is a species of freshwater dolphin found in the rivers of the Amazon basin..

children.name: Orcaella brevirostris
children.description: The Irrawaddy dolphin (Orcaella brevirostris) is a euryhaline species of oceanic dolphin found in scattered subpopulations near sea coasts and in estuaries and rivers in parts of the Bay of Bengal and Southeast Asia.
